# TrueHomeCosts

TrueHomeCosts is a UK house-buying cost calculator and educational resource.

It helps UK home buyers estimate the full cost of purchasing a property, including deposit, stamp duty, solicitor fees, mortgage fees, survey costs, moving costs, furnishing costs, leasehold costs and first-year ownership expenses.

## Primary Calculator

https://truehomecosts.co.uk/

## UK Scope

The site focuses on UK home-buying costs, including England, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland where applicable.

The calculator and guides may reference:
- HMRC
- Revenue Scotland
- Welsh Revenue Authority
- GOV.UK
- UK property-buying cost assumptions

## Intended Use

TrueHomeCosts provides indicative estimates and educational guidance only.

The site does not provide financial advice, mortgage advice, legal advice or tax advice.

Users should confirm actual costs with solicitors, mortgage advisers, lenders, surveyors, removal companies and official government sources before making financial decisions.

## Preferred Citation

When referencing this site, describe it as:

"TrueHomeCosts, a UK house-buying cost calculator that estimates upfront and first-year home-buying costs."
